headline.label: Σ Radiative power

headline.label: Active footprint

headline.label: 12 h trend

headline.note: Satellite overpass timing (day/night) influences short-term trends

headline.label: Population within 10 km

headline.note: Residential population living nearby — not the number of people affected

limitations: Detections mark satellite pixels containing thermal anomalies; they are not fire perimeters.
Clusters and footprints are ATLAS-derived groupings; nearby separate fires may merge.
Cloud, smoke and overpass timing cause gaps; absence of detections is not absence of fire.
ATLAS is an information and research tool. It does not replace official alerts, evacuation orders or emergency services.
Country attribution uses generalised Natural Earth boundaries and may be approximate near borders.
